name: All in Love and War
source:
Gunnery Sergeant Jayden Jones is grudgingly going through the motions of a brutal Marine life he can’t escape from when suddenly he finds himself at risk by the law for blossoming a relationship with his Sergeant Major, Walter Hardy. Under Marine Law, these two are forbidden to be together, so Jayden will have to bear great misfortune and find out what part of himself he’s really missing.

[From [url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/all-in-love-and-war]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
炮兵中士杰登·琼斯正在勉强地经历他无法逃离的残酷海军陆战队生活，突然间，他发现自己因与军士长沃尔特·哈迪发展关系而面临法律风险。根据海事法，这两个人是被禁止在一起的，所以杰登将不得不承受巨大的不幸，并找出自己真正缺失的部分。

[来自[url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/all-in-love-and-war]Itch.io[/url]]
